title: Home-Delivery Bridge for Maintenance Drugs on Retail Transition Supplies (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a retail transition supply of a maintenance drug that is moving to the mail carries a home-delivery bridge. The bridge turns on records of the member's Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: the member's maintenance choice, the network's maintenance list, and how the network applies its maintenance rule. When a figure is added, it comes from the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy program.

## Bridge clause

| Member's retail maintenance choice | Drug on the network's maintenance list | Network's maintenance rule | Bridge added |
|---|---|---|---|
| home delivery | yes | any | the standard shipping time of the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy program, in business days, added as that number of days |
| undecided | yes | applied after the courtesy fills, whether it sends the drug to home delivery only or to home delivery or a ninety-day retail fill | the maintenance-choice grace of **5** days |
| any other combination | | | none |

The bridge is added to the supply before the supply is held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

## Basis Q&A

*The member has not yet made a maintenance choice, the drug is on the list, and the network applies its maintenance rule after the courtesy fills. What is added?* The grace of 5 days.

*The member chose home delivery, and the Home Delivery Pharmacy program's standard shipping time is 3 business days (a hypothetical figure). What is added?* 3 days.

*The drug is not on the network's maintenance list.* No bridge is added, whatever the member's choice.
